budget_signal.initial: Budget is approved for the planned implementation.
budget_signal.current: Budget remains approved but implementation timing is becoming more important.

deal_risk.reason: The customer has an increasingly urgent implementation timeline and requires security approval.

calls.transcript: Emily Carter explained that NovaRetail is evaluating solutions to improve its digital commerce operations. She said the company has an approved budget and is primarily focused on completing the implementation before the next major retail season. The sales representative explained the expected implementation approach and timeline.

James Wilson reviewed the technical capabilities of the platform. He asked about integration with NovaRetail's existing e-commerce platform. Emily also said that NovaRetail was comparing the solution with HubSpot and wanted to understand whether the proposed platform provided enough features to justify switching.

Rachel Adams joined the discussion to review security requirements. She explained that NovaRetail requires a security assessment before approving the implementation. She requested information about data protection, access controls, and the security review process.

Emily Carter said the approved budget remains available, but the implementation timeline has become more urgent because the retail season is approaching. She said NovaRetail needs confidence that the security review and integration work can be completed without delaying the launch.
